title: Commuting cost addition with bind and map
statement: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on pairs consisting of an outcome in $\alpha$ and a learning cost, let $q$ assign to each outcome in $\alpha$ a probability mass function on pairs consisting of an outcome in $\beta$ and a learning cost, and fix an additional learning cost $e$. Binding $p$ to the law obtained by adding the first-stage cost to each cost from $q$, then adding $e$, gives the same law as first adding $e$ to the cost drawn from $p$ and then binding to the law obtained by adding that first-stage cost to each cost from $q$.
hypotheses_covered: A probability mass function on outcome-cost pairs with outcomes in $\alpha$
